title: Persona-Guided LLM Agents for Task-Oriented Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2608.18085v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prior work has shown that large language models (LLMs) can express diverse personality traits in open-ended text generation. However, it remains unclear whether they can do so in a goal-directed dialogue without compromising task completion, and whether adapting to the user's personality improves the interaction quality. We study these questions in task-oriented dialogue (TOD), where a system helps a user accomplish a goal via multi-turn interaction. We build a training-free framework that simulates a TOD interaction between two LLMs: a user agent that exhibits a target personality and a system agent that adapts to the user while completing the task. To isolate the effect of adaptation, we vary how much the system knows about the user's personality across three conditions. In Neutral, the system receives no personality information. translated_title: 基于人格引导的大语言模型代理用于任务导向对话
translated_abstract: 先前的研究表明，大型语言模型（LLMs）在开放式文本生成中能够表达多样的人格特质。然而，尚不清楚它们是否能在目标导向的对话中做到这一点而不损害任务完成度，以及适应用户的人格是否能提升交互质量。我们在任务导向对话（TOD）中研究这些问题，其中系统通过多轮交互帮助用户实现目标。我们构建了一个无需训练的框架，模拟两个LLM之间的TOD交互：一个表现出目标人格的用户代理，以及一个在完成任务的同时适应用户的系统代理。为了隔离适应的影响，我们在三种条件下变化系统对用户人格的了解程度。在“中性”条件下，系统不接收人格信息；在“尝试”条件下，它从对话线索中推断人格；在“预言”条件下，它被明确给予人格信息。
tldr: 本研究提出一个无需训练的框架，通过模拟两个大语言模型代理的任务导向对话，验证了系统适应用户人格能在不损害任务完成度的前提下提升交互质量。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a training-free framework that simulates task-oriented dialogue between two LLM agents, demonstrating that system adaptation to user personality improves interaction quality without compromising task completion.
